description: This PHP source file defines the ViewHistory class, which extends SugarView, and is responsible for rendering a tree view of modules in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface. It includes methods for generating module title parameters, displaying the module tree, and building nodes for individual modules.

classes.name: ViewHistory
classes.description: A class extending SugarView that provides functionality to display a tree of modules in the SuiteCRM ModuleBuilder interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns parameters for the module title, including translated module name and module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Creates a root node, loads modules via StudioBrowser, adds nodes for each module, and outputs the JSON-encoded tree.

methods.name: buildStudioNode
methods.description: Stub method intended to build an ExtNode from a StudioModule.
